invariants.description: P_baro matches the exact first-order solution X + (P_baro_init - X) exp(-t/tau_pb), X = P_sys + tau_zb dP_sys_dt
f_ab is the static sigmoid of P_baro (exact algebraic identity)
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs(f_ab - (f_ab_min + f_ab_max*np.exp((P_baro - P_nom)/k_ab))/(1 + np.exp((P_baro - P_nom)/k_ab)))) <= 1e-8*max(1.0, f_ab_max)

invariants.description: afferent firing stays between its saturation levels f_ab_min and f_ab_max

bc_sweep.rationale: P_sys 50-200 mmHg (hypotension to severe hypertension, mean or systolic); dP_sys_dt +-2000 Pa/s (15 mmHg/s, slow ramps; pulsatile dP/dt is far larger but the input is meant to be smoothed); P_nom 80-110 mmHg around the Ursino 92 mmHg set point; time constants and slopes 0.5-2x the Ursino values; saturations spanning reported afferent ranges.

baseline.reason: Candidate: the static carotid-sinus afferent firing vs sinus pressure curve that Ursino 1998 fitted (f_min, f_max, P_n, k_a); the underlying data (and the paper) are paywalled and could not be obtained. An open alternative is a human neck-chamber HR-pressure sigmoid, but that validates the whole reflex arc, not this afferent block.

calibrate.note: pending: same data as baseline would identify P_nom, k_ab, f_ab_min, f_ab_max
